_doc: Per-demon mastery (Progression). Every run with a demon earns mastery XP: base + per_minute * minutes + per_kill * kills + per_level * player level + per_boss * bosses + victory, times (1 + heat_bonus * heat). XP to go from level n to n+1 = level_base + level_step * (n - 1); max_level caps it. rewards: {level: [reward]} for every demon; demons.<model id>.rewards add demon-specific ones. Reward kinds: {signature: rank} activates/upgrades the demon's signature boon; {skin: id} announces a skin from data/skins/skins.json (its unlock is {"unlock": "mastery:<model id>:<level>"}, or "mastery:any:<level>" for any demon); {currency: id, amount: n} pays once. Signature effects use the upgrade effect format ({stat, per_level} / {ability_mod, per_level}); rank II applies them twice.

signature.name: Ravager's Fury
signature.description: Brimstone and melee abilities hit harder and hurl angels further; +20 max HP.

signature.name: Hymn of Cinders
signature.description: Hellfire abilities hit harder and every ability hit may set the Host alight.

signature.name: Hexbinder's Litany
signature.description: Curses stack higher and land on their own; weapons recover a little faster.

signature.name: Warden's Shackles
signature.description: Binds last longer, bound angels suffer more, and lightning forks further along the chains.

signature.name: Pale Harvest
signature.description: Reaps more souls and holds more of them; Shadow abilities cut deeper.

signature.name: Queen of the Swarm
signature.description: Plague abilities spread faster and bite harder; the hive keeps its host alive.

signature.name: Thirty Pieces of Light
signature.description: Envy abilities strike harder and every hit may covet the Host's strength; he moves like a traitor.
